X-Correlation-Id.description: The correlation id: the caller-supplied UUID when valid, otherwise a new one.

X-RateLimit-Limit.bucket.description: Per-address authentication bucket: attempts allowed. Sent once the bucket has been consumed (not on a request refused earlier, such as a validation or CSRF failure). This bucket sends no `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

X-RateLimit-Limit.either.description: The general limiter on the bearer path, the refresh bucket on the cookie path.

X-RateLimit-Limit.general.description: General per-principal limiter: requests allowed in the window. Sent once authentication has succeeded, so absent on a `401` and on refusals raised before the limiter runs.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.either.description: The general limiter on the bearer path, the refresh bucket on the cookie path.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.general.description: General limiter: requests left in the window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.general.description: General limiter: seconds until the window resets.

X-Request-Id.description: A new id for this request.

X-Acc-Organization.description: Selects the organization to act in (`API.md` §3). Required when the principal can reach more than one; an organization outside the principal’s scope is refused.
X-Acc-Organization.name: X-Acc-Organization

X-Acc-Refresh.description: CSRF marker for the cookie-authenticated routes: any value; its absence is `403 AUTHZ_PERMISSION_DENIED`.
X-Acc-Refresh.name: X-Acc-Refresh

X-Causation-Id.description: Optional UUID of the event or request that caused this one; any other value is ignored.
X-Causation-Id.name: X-Causation-Id

X-Correlation-Id.description: Optional caller-supplied UUID; any other value is replaced by a new id.
X-Correlation-Id.name: X-Correlation-Id

secret.description: The secret half of the credential — returned once, on the creating response only; the credential is `<prefix>.<secret>`. An idempotent replay returns `null`.

correlationId.description: The request correlation id, also sent as `X-Correlation-Id`.

details.description: Code-specific detail. `VALIDATION_FAILED` carries `issues: ValidationIssue[]`; lifecycle conflicts carry `status`; `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` from the general limiter carries `retryAfterSeconds`.

retryable.description: True only where an identical retry is safe and may succeed; clients must check it before retrying.

roleId.description: The role id — for an API key, the synthetic `api_key:<key id>` of its effective grant.

nextCursor.description: Opaque, integrity-protected cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

circuitCooldownUntil.description: When an open circuit's cooldown ends; null in any other state

circuitState.description: Moved only by the circuit breaker (Phase 2.3)

healthOverride.description: The manual health pin; null when health is derived automatically

healthState.description: Derived from samples, or the manual override when set (Phase 2.3)

circuitCooldownUntil.description: When an open circuit's cooldown ends; null in any other state

circuitState.description: Moved only by the circuit breaker (Phase 2.3)

healthOverride.description: The manual health pin; null when health is derived automatically

healthState.description: Derived from samples, or the manual override when set (Phase 2.3)

circuitProbe.description: Whether this submission was the circuit's half-open probe

revoked.description: The number of live sessions revoked.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

field.description: Dotted path from the request root, e.g. `permissions.0`.

apiKey.description: An API key, sent in the same header as a session token: `Authorization: Bearer ak_live_…`. Bound to one organization; never holds platform or reseller authority.

refreshCookie.description: The httpOnly refresh cookie, path-scoped to `/api/v1/auth`. Accepted only together with the `X-Acc-Refresh` header.
refreshCookie.name: acc_refresh

userSession.description: A signed-in user session: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.

info.description: ACC control-plane API. Envelopes: `{data}` for a resource, `{data, page}` for a cursor-paginated list, `{error}` for every failure (`API.md` §7–§8).
